title: RBI Monetary Policy Committee Decisions — August 2026
summary: MPC keeps Repo Rate unchanged at 6.50%; maintains withdrawal of accommodation stance.

blocks.content: The Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee (MPC), headed by the RBI Governor, met on August 8-10, 2026, and decided by a 5:1 majority to keep the policy Repo Rate unchanged.

blocks.context: Maintained status quo for the 9th consecutive meeting

items: Real GDP Growth Projection: Retained at 7.2% for FY 2026-27 (Q1: 7.1%, Q2: 7.2%, Q3: 7.3%, Q4: 7.2%).
CPI Inflation Projection: Maintained at 4.5% for FY 2026-27 assuming normal monsoon.
Headline Inflation Target: 4.0% (+/- 2% tolerance band under RBI Act 1934 Section 45ZA).

blocks.title: Exam Trap: MPC Composition & Voting Quorum
blocks.content: The MPC consists of 6 members: 3 from RBI (including Governor as ex-officio Chairperson with casting vote) and 3 external members appointed by Central Govt.
blocks.trapDetails: Decisions are taken by majority vote. In case of a tie, the RBI Governor has a casting vote.
